message_def.name: SetTime
message_def.description: Time is configured within a JAUS system using the following message. Accuracy of the time may be dependent on latencies in the transmission of the message. Proper systems engineering procedures should be used to insure the accuracy of the time messages are within the system tolerance. All times are in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: QueryTime
message_def.description: This message is used by clients of this service to query the current time of this service.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

fixed_field.name: PresenceVector
fixed_field.interpretation: See corresponding report time message for presence vector mapping

message_def.name: ReportTime
message_def.description: This message is used to report the current time of this service to querying clients. All times are in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message
